title: MoralQuest: AI-Powered Gamification of Indian Moral Tales for Neurodiverse Social Development in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
summary: MoralQuest is developing an AI-supported storytelling MVP to personalize learning and social-development activities for autistic children.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Christ University describes interactive moral tales, adaptive difficulty, rewards, and a caregiver dashboard. The minimum viable product is under development. The proposed benefits include personalized learning, emotional support, and social inclusion, without reported child-level outcomes or a completed learning evaluation.
purpose: Personalize interactive learning and social-development activities.

ratings.reason: MoralQuest is in MVP development; no child learning or communication outcome is reported.
Greater educational equity for autistic children is an intended outcome.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 17: MoralQuest: AI-Powered Gamification of Indian Moral Tales for Neurodiverse Social Development in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: MoralQuest proposes personalized learning for autistic children
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
